label: Stata: Do File
command: if command -v send-to-stata.sh &>/dev/null; then send-to-stata.sh --file-mode --file "$ZED_FILE"; elif [ -f "$APPDATA/Zed/stata/send-to-stata.exe" ]; then "$APPDATA/Zed/stata/send-to-stata.exe" -FileMode -File "$ZED_FILE"; else echo "Send-to-Stata not installed."; echo ""; echo "Sending code to Stata requires an additional tool that communicates with the Stata application."; echo ""; echo "Install with:"; echo "  macOS:   /bin/bash -c \"\$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbearak/zed-stata/main/tools/send-to-stata/install-macos.sh)\""; echo "  Windows: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbearak/zed-stata/main/tools/send-to-stata/install-windows.ps1 | iex"; echo ""; echo "Documentation: https://github.com/jbearak/zed-stata/tree/main/tools/send-to-stata"; exit 1; fi

label: Stata: Do Statement
command: if command -v send-to-stata.sh &>/dev/null; then python3 -c 'import os,sys; sys.exit(0 if os.environ.get("ZED_SELECTED_TEXT", "") else 1)' && python3 -c 'import os,sys; sys.stdout.write(os.environ.get("ZED_SELECTED_TEXT", ""))' | send-to-stata.sh --statement --stdin --file "$ZED_FILE" || send-to-stata.sh --statement --file "$ZED_FILE" --row "$ZED_ROW"; elif [ -f "$APPDATA/Zed/stata/send-to-stata.exe" ]; then "$APPDATA/Zed/stata/send-to-stata.exe" -Statement -File "$ZED_FILE" -Row "$ZED_ROW"; else echo "Send-to-Stata not installed."; echo ""; echo "Sending code to Stata requires an additional tool that communicates with the Stata application."; echo ""; echo "Install with:"; echo "  macOS:   /bin/bash -c \"\$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbearak/zed-stata/main/tools/send-to-stata/install-macos.sh)\""; echo "  Windows: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbearak/zed-stata/main/tools/send-to-stata/install-windows.ps1 | iex"; echo ""; echo "Documentation: https://github.com/jbearak/zed-stata/tree/main/tools/send-to-stata"; exit 1; fi
